changed_lines_vs_draft: +These are Edge connector tools. Call each one through Edge's `use_tool` with its tool id, for example `use_tool {"tool":"whatsapp.status","input":{}}`. If your Edge connector does not list them, run `find_tool` with "connect my WhatsApp to Edge" first.
-   - Call that network's Edge connect tool (`whatsapp.connect`, `linkedin.connect`, `instagram.connect`, `email.connect`).
+   - Call that network's status tool first. If it already says connected, go to the next network.
-   - Wait until the user says done, then call the network's status tool to confirm. If it is not connected, give the link again once.
-3. Show it works: list the 3 latest chats of each connected network (names and times only).

+   - Wait until the user says done, then call the network's status tool to confirm. If it is not connected, call the connect tool again for a fresh link (each link works for 10 minutes) and give it once.
+3. Show it works: call the latest-chats tool of each connected network with `{"limit": 3}` and list the 3 latest chats (names and times only).
-   - "Your posts and drafts are on your board: getedge.cc/you/board"
+   - "Your LinkedIn drafts and scheduled posts: ask me 'show my LinkedIn drafts'."
+   When the user asks for them, call `linkedin.post_drafts` and `linkedin.scheduled_posts`.
-- If a connect tool says the account is not in the beta, tell the user: "This is invite-only right now. Ask Federico to add you."
